lab_results.notes: Mapped from a producer-supplied Certificate of Analysis for WeedDAO interoperability review. Original certificate artwork/signatures not republished. Laboratory branded as external-lab-002. Batch ID on certificate is the literal string '0' — preserved as cultivation_batch_id string '0' (NOT converted to null). Detected cannabinoids/terpenes mapped with unit '%'. ND cannabinoid/terpene rows omitted from core. Heavy metal <0.008 ppm omitted from numeric values. Multi-unit mg/g and mg/unit in extensions.weeddao_review. See docs/review-cases/coa-003-gaps.md.

pesticides.notes: COA states Passed; No pesticides detected. Per-analyte ND rows not coerced to numeric zeros.

heavy_metals.notes: COA panel Passed. As/Cd/Pb/Hg each reported as <0.008 ppm — below-reporting-limit strings NOT encoded as value 0. Confirms GitHub issue #1. Per-analyte < strings retained in extensions.weeddao_review.

microbials.notes: COA panel Passed. Yeast/Mold, Salmonella, E.coli reported ND. SafetyAnalyteResult 'not_detected' used for organisms.

residual_solvents.notes: COA panel Passed. Listed solvents PASS with limit 5000 ppm each.

provenance.notes: Laboratory results transcribed from a producer-authorized COA for WeedDAO development/review. WeedDAO does not independently re-verify laboratory measurements. Producer Texas Original and TX license 0005 disclosed; laboratory branded identity redacted to external-lab-002. Batch ID literal '0' preserved as string.

weeddao_review.batch_id_ambiguity_note: Certificate shows literal batch ID '0'. Preserved as cultivation_batch_id string '0'. Do NOT convert to null. Ambiguous whether this is a placeholder, missing print, or intentional token — documented for review; not silently dropped.
semantic_notes: ND (Not Detected) is NOT zero and is NOT not_measured.
Heavy metal <0.008 ppm is NOT value 0.
Residual solvent PASS is NOT ND.
Batch ID '0' must remain string '0', not null.
Cannabinoid/terpene ND cannot be encoded in core CannabinoidMeasurement/TerpeneEntry.
